directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。

entries.EN: Do you happen to have any special tips or info about the Zone?
entries.JA_current: Do you happen to have any special tips or info about the Zone?
entries.JA_new: ゾーンで役に立つ特別な情報はないか？

entries.EN: I may have just the perfect thing for ya, "hero". You know what they say, "True heroes always take the roundabout ways", you heard that one? He-he. I'm sure THIS info will really suit you. But the price is really high, and there's absolutely no refunds. Ready to fork over 50 grand of cabbage?

entries.JA_new: 「英雄」さんにぴったりの情報があるぞ。聞いたことないか？ 「本当の英雄は回り道をする」って。へへっ。お前にはこの情報が役立つはずだ。だが、値段はかなり高い。返金もなしだ。5万ルーブル払う気はあるか？

entries.EN: 50 G's!? Fuck... Ok, here's the money. Better be worth it!
entries.JA_current: 50 G's!? Fuck... Ok, here's the money. Better be worth it!
entries.JA_new: 5万だって！？ くそっ……分かった、金だ。払うだけの価値はあるんだろうな！

entries.EN: Are you crazy?! What kind of info could possibly be worth this amount?! Go outside, I think you could do with a breath of fresh air!
entries.JA_current: Are you crazy?! What kind of info could possibly be worth this amount?! Go outside, I think you could do with a breath of fresh air!
entries.JA_new: 正気か！？ どんな情報ならそんな値段がつくんだ？ 外へ出て、少し風に当たってこい！

entries.EN: So, listen. The Barkeep often plays host for people who are not quite welcome on Duty's territory. So, there is actually a small, secret wormhole leading directly to the barns of the Bar. It was made by a stalker they called Physic or Psychic, whatever. How did he manage it? Don't ask me things I have no idea of - that guy was way smarter about the quirks of the Zone than all those eggheads taken together. You'll find the entrance to the wormhole in the backyard of the Bar, where nobody ever pokes his nose.

entries.JA_new: よく聞け。バーキープは、デューティーの縄張りじゃ歓迎されない奴らを、よくここに泊めてる。実は、バーの倉庫へ直通する小さな秘密のワームホールがあるんだ。フィジックかサイキックとか呼ばれてたストーカーが作った。どうやったかって？ 俺が知るわけないだろ。あいつはゾーンの癖を、学者連中なんかよりずっとよく分かってた。入口はバーの裏庭だ。誰も近寄らない場所にある。

entries.EN: Thanks, I'll keep an eye for it. The info is really precious.
entries.JA_current: Thanks, I'll keep an eye for it. The info is really precious.
entries.JA_new: 気をつけて探してみる。かなり貴重な情報だな。
